title: Repair portable SP_CORE compatibility fix after Inspector block
objective: Address Inspector's blocker for the post-rebase SPEAR config compatibility fix: the current test depends on ignored local examples/flashlight/user_config.yaml, so make the compatibility behavior and tests portable in tracked source.
instructions: Read the Inspector ResultPacket at .control-tower/packets/inbox/inspector-db05de6c-e7d5-4c2b-b95d-28fa7cc987fd-result.json and Builder ResultPacket at .control-tower/packets/inbox/builder-5e4f0bb8-7071-482e-89bb-a369d2b63921-result.json.
Fix the high-severity portability issue: tests/test_orbit_collection_validation.py must not depend on ignored local examples/flashlight/user_config.yaml existing in a clean checkout.

Preserve the local runtime compatibility for stale standalone binaries that still query SP_CORE *_INI_CONFIG_VALUES. Prefer a minimal tracked-code solution if appropriate, or make the test use a temporary config fixture that explicitly exercises the compatibility merge.
If you need to change run_orbit_collection.py, keep it narrowly scoped to config compatibility and avoid unrelated refactors.
Run py_compile and the orbit validation unit tests. Do not launch a long simulator render.
constraints: Do not commit, push, reset, clean, or discard user changes.

artifacts: Post-rebase SP_CORE compatibility shim is conceptually correct for stale pre-d4cdee3e standalone binaries, but tracked tests must not depend on ignored examples/*/user_config.yaml files.

expected_outputs: Builder ResultPacket with files changed, root cause, validation, and whether Inspector should re-review.
definition_of_done: Inspector's portability blocker is resolved without losing the runtime compatibility fix.
